style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 4ft 11 Pre Lit Plug In Christmas Wall Tree Light
style.toneOfVoice: The 1.5m Pre Lit Gold Plug In Christmas Wall Tree Light makes the winter truly special. Tired of shedding pines? The gold plug in wall tree is fuss free, no nonsense, and, if treated with care, long lasting. The LED lights can turn on at the same time each evening and off again automatically, with the optional 6-hour timer. There s also a constant ‘on’ mode. With its golden shine, the tree enhances a space, making the everyday magical and putting the special in special occasions. There are 144 micro-LEDs dotted on the branches of the black frame. The pre lit wall tree light is a piece of the season, the gift that keeps glowing. Dimensions(mm): Height: 150 Width: 150 Depth: 150.
